remarks: Welcome Home! Absolutely stunning 4BR 4.5 Bath colonial in highly sought after neighborhood. This luxurious home has been completely redone & is the definition of turnkey! The main level is sure to please from the moment you walk through the front door & features an inviting foyer w/ custom-built center staircase/wine rack. Enjoy the best of both worlds w/ the lovely wood burning fireplace in the sun-filled family room & gas fireplace in the open-concept living room/kitchen. Modern, designer kitchen boasts high-end luxury appliances, 48'' Wolf Range, paneled Sub-Zero column refrigerator/freezer, center island w/ 2.5'' waterfall countertop & tons of cabinet space! Also on this floor is a cozy sun-room, formal dining room area w/ tiled accent wall, beverage center & powder room. The Primary BR Suite comes fully equipped w/ vaulted ceilings, amazing en suite w/ tile shower & freestanding soaking tub, ample closet space, & charming walkout balcony. 2nd level also offers 3 additional spacious bedrooms & 2 full baths that look like something out of a magazine! As if that weren't enough, the lower level is fully finished and provides the ultimate entertaining space. This incredible home also boasts central A/C, Andersen windows, Navien tankless water heater, separate laundry room, recessed lighting & gleaming white oak hardwood floors throughout! Close proximity to Calf Pasture Beach, Shorehaven Golf Club, SoNo Collections, train station, highway access, tons of restaurants & more!
